# usePrefetchIntent

Calls the app's `prefetch(key)` when a person shows intent to open something: a mouse or pen resting on it, keyboard focus, or a touch beginning. Ouro owns the intent and the budget; the app owns what is fetched and where it is kept, so any data layer fits.

```tsx
import { usePrefetchIntent } from "@/registry/ouro/lib/ouro/use-prefetch-intent";
```

## Example

```tsx
const intent = usePrefetchIntent((id) => queryClient.prefetchQuery(recipe(id)), recipeId);
<a href={`/recipes/${recipeId}`} {...intent}>Pancakes</a>
```

## Usage

The budget: a key is prefetched once until it goes stale, at most `maxInflight` prefetches run at once across the targets that share the function, a refused or skipped one is retried by the next intent, and nothing is prefetched when the browser asks to save data. The function's errors are swallowed, so a failed prefetch never breaks the page.

Spread it on a `Link` for a route: Link passes the handlers to its anchor.

## Use instead when

- Use the Speculation Rules API instead when the browser should prerender whole documents.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `prefetch` | `((key: string) => unknown) \| undefined` |  |
| `key` | `string` |  |
| `options` | `PrefetchIntentOptions` | `{}` |

## Returns

`PrefetchIntentHandlers`

## Types

### `PrefetchIntentHandlers`

The handlers `usePrefetchIntent` returns; spread them on the element.

```ts
interface PrefetchIntentHandlers {
  onPointerEnter: (event: PointerEvent<HTMLElement>) => void;
  onPointerLeave: (event: PointerEvent<HTMLElement>) => void;
  onFocus: (event: FocusEvent<HTMLElement>) => void;
  onTouchStart: (event: TouchEvent<HTMLElement>) => void;
}
```

### `PrefetchIntentOptions`

Options for `usePrefetchIntent`.

```ts
interface PrefetchIntentOptions {
  /** How long a mouse or pen rests on the target before it counts as intent, in milliseconds. @default 65 */
  delay?: number | undefined;
  /** How many prefetches the app's function may have running at once, shared by the targets that use the same function. @default 2 */
  maxInflight?: number | undefined;
  /** How long a prefetched key stays fresh, in milliseconds; after that the next intent prefetches it again. @default 30000 */
  staleAfter?: number | undefined;
}
```
